repoChecks: `cargo test` at the repo root runs everything on the Rust side, plus `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` (mirrors CI; see CONTRIBUTING.md). If you touched the Python engine, also run `uv run pytest` in `engine/` (after `uv sync` there). If you touched the acceptance gate, run `uv run pytest` in `acceptance/` (after `uv sync` there); without `uv`/`git`/`cargo`/`npm` and a Chromium the installed-artifact legs skip and only the harness's own tests run. If you touched `website/`, run its four checks — `python3 tests/check_site.py`, `check_html.py`, `check_links.py`, `check_schemas.py` — from that directory; `check_schemas.py` needs network access to raw.githubusercontent.com.
